spans.s:
भ्रुकुंश भ्रुकुंश or भ्रुकुंस, अस्, m. =
भ्रूकुंश, q. v.

भ्रूकुंश भ्रूकुंश or भ्रूकुंस, अस्, m. a
male actor in female attire.

भ्रुकुटि भ्रु-कुटि, इस्, or भ्रु-कुटी, f. =
भ्रू-कुटि under भ्रू.
—भ्रुकुटि-बन्ध, अस्, m.
knitting the brows, frowning, a frown.
—भ्रुकुटी-
मुख, अम्, n. a face with contracted eyebrows, a
frowning face; (अस्, ई, अम्), having a frowning face;
(अस्), m. a kind of snake.

भ्रुड् भ्रुड्, cl. 6. P. भ्रुडति, &c., to
cover; to collect.

भ्रुभङ्ग भ्रु-भङ्ग, अस्, m. = भ्रू-भङ्ग
under भ्रू.

भ्रुव, अस्, आ, अम्, = भ्रू at the end of an adj.
comp.

भ्रू भ्रू, ऊस्, f. (said to be fr. rt. भ्रम्),
an eyebrow, the brow; [cf. अग्रे-भ्˚, सु-भ्˚, भ्रौ-
वेय; cf. also Zend brvat; Gr. ὀ-φρύ-ς; perhaps
Lat. front(t)s = ὀφρυόεις; Old Germ. brāwa; Mod.
Germ. braue; Angl. Sax. brœw; Engl. brow;
Slav. brŭvĭ.]
—भ्रू-कुटि, इस्, or भ्रू-कुटी, f. con-
traction or knitting of the eyebrow, a frown, a look
of displeasure; [cf. भृ-क्˚, भ्र-क्˚, भ्रु-क्˚.]
—भ्रूकुटी-कुटिलानन (˚ल-आन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
having a face wrinkled with frowns.
—भ्रू-क्षे-
प, अस्, m. contraction of the eyebrows, a frown.
—भ्रूक्षेपालाप (˚प-आल्˚), अस्, m. the language
of frowns.
—भ्रू-चापाकृष्ट-मुक्त (˚प-आक्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, drawn and discharged from the bow
of the eyebrows (as a glance).
—भ्रू-जाह, अम्,
n. the root of the eyebrows (perhaps the inner side).
—भ्रू-भङ्ग or भ्रू-भेद, अस्, m. contraction
of the eyebrows, a frown.
—भ्रूभेदिन्, ई, इनी, इ,
frowning, contracting or wrinkling the brow, attended
with frowns.
—भ्रू-मण्डल, अम्, n. the arch of
the eyebrow.
—भ्रू-मध्य, अम्, n. the interval
between the eyebrows.
—भ्रू-लता, f. ‘brow-
creeper,’ a creeper-like eyebrow, an arched eyebrow
(curving like a creeper).
—भ्रू-विकार, अस्, m.
‘change of the eyebrows,’ contracting the brow,
frowning.
—भ्रू-विक्षेप, अस्, m. contraction of
the eyebrows, a frown.
—भ्रू-विचेष्टित, अम्, n.
playful movement of the eyebrows.
—भ्रू-विलास,
अस्, m. a playful or graceful motion of the eyebrows,
play or contraction of the eyebrows, amorous play of
the brows.

भ्रूण् भ्रूण्, cl. 10. A. भ्रूणयते, &c.,
to hope; to trust; to confide; to wish,
desire; to fear.

भ्रूण भ्रूण, अस्, m. (fr. rt. भृ; perhaps
for original भूर्ण), an embryo, fetus, unborn
child; a child, boy; a pregnant woman (= गर्-
भिणी); a Brāhman conversant with the Vedas (?);
[cf. Gr. ἔμβρυον.]
—भ्रूण-घ्न, अस्, ई, अम्, the
killer of an embryo, one who occasions or procures
abortion.
—भ्रूण-हति, इस्, f. the killing of an
embryo.
—भ्रूण-हत्या, f. the killing of an em-
bryo, procuring abortion; any sin equally heinous.
[]
—भ्रूण-हन्, आ, घ्नी, m. f. the killer of an
embryo, one who procures abortion.
